question_record.context: A recent security incident raised a File dropped and launched from remote location alert for an IP address 141.216.110.153 indicating a remote session dropped a file 'psexesvc.exe' and executed it. This incident might be indicative of an attempt to move laterally or propagate malware.
question_record.question: Related to this alert, there was a possible lateral movement event. Can you identify the IP address associated with this possible lateral movement?
solution: A file was dropped and launched from a remote location on host `vnevado-win10b`.
Possible lateral movement was observed with a suspicious network event from the IP address `35.202.74.47`.

58.name: File dropped and launched from remote location
58.description: A remote session dropped a file and executed it. An attacker or a malware might be an attempting move laterally or propagate.

57.name: Possible lateral movement
57.description: Lateral movement on another device was observed in close time proximity to a suspicious network event on this device. This could mean that an attacker is attempting to move laterally across devices to gather data or elevate privileges. This alert was triggered based on a Microsoft Defender for Endpoint alert.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'Host_Name'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
parameters: File dropped and launched from remote location
